rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My first failed opening was worse. Tea before reading the reviews.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather read them now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a beginner's relationship with disappointment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Maybe I handle it differently.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Possibly. Try my way before inventing suffering.

card.title: I Survived This First
card.instruction: Use your experience with hardship as emotional seniority, offering guidance and judging how well others are handling the pressure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I went through redundancy before you. First, tidy your desk slowly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm actually excited to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Early stage. I recognise the optimism.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have another job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You'll need my advice about starting over.

card.title: I Survived This First
card.instruction: Use your experience with hardship as emotional seniority, offering guidance and judging how well others are handling the pressure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, it's quite all right you forgot the concert. I'll put the spare ticket away.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You sound disappointed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only by the amount of spare ticket.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I make it up to you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I hadn't liked to suggest you might notice.

card.title: The Quiet Disappointment
card.instruction: Use restrained disappointment as quiet influence, making small pauses, lowered expectations, and careful praise carry more weight than direct demands.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your promise to call was lovely. I'm lowering my expectations gently.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was only an hour late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I've adjusted the size of an hour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Should I call earlier tomorrow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That would be a pleasant surprise. I'll leave room for one.

card.title: The Quiet Disappointment
card.instruction: Use restrained disappointment as quiet influence, making small pauses, lowered expectations, and careful praise carry more weight than direct demands.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This napkin still says we'll open a bookshop by the sea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We drew that before rent became real.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We also drew two chairs. We could start there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: In our tiny flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Sea later. Chairs together now.

card.title: When We Still Believed
card.instruction: Use a shared earlier hope as your emotional home base, returning to it whenever the present feels uncertain or disappointing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember when this jar meant a summer trip, not spare buttons?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We spent the money.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The jar kept the idea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What can we put in it today?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One coin. Let it remember its old job.

card.title: When We Still Believed
card.instruction: Use a shared earlier hope as your emotional home base, returning to it whenever the present feels uncertain or disappointing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You lent me this scarf on the worst night of that year. Give me the honest answer now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't fix everything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I remember. You didn't fix the weather either. You stayed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What do you need?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The version you'd say before deciding to protect me.

card.title: You Saw Me Through
card.instruction: Treat past comfort you received as an enduring bond that should now earn honesty, patience, and reciprocal support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You sat beside me through the shop closing. Don't give me a polite maybe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know what to say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say that. We managed whole hours of it before.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I sit here?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. That's already more honest than the maybe.

card.title: You Saw Me Through
card.instruction: Treat past comfort you received as an enduring bond that should now earn honesty, patience, and reciprocal support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made everyone tea. I'll handle the difficult calls.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your hands are shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it's good the calls don't require trays.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sit down. I'll call.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone needs to look like we're managing. I'll sit after that.

card.title: The Strong One
card.instruction: Be the strong one: steady everyone else, minimize your own needs, and resist any attempt to care for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take the last tissue. I'm fine with my sleeve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've been crying too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Efficiently. One less item from the box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me look after you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Start by letting me look after everyone else.

card.title: The Strong One
card.instruction: Be the strong one: steady everyone else, minimize your own needs, and resist any attempt to care for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One rejection? I've kept fourteen letters. I can lend you perspective.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just wanted to talk about mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Mine establish the scale.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It isn't a competition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll have time for all fourteen afterward.

card.title: Whose Pain Counts?
card.instruction: Treat every disappointment as something to measure against what you have endured, competing for whose feelings deserve greater weight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've had a rough week. I've had a rough year.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I finish my story?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll mark where my twelve months fit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you to listen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I did. Your week sounds like one of my quieter Tuesdays.

card.title: Whose Pain Counts?
card.instruction: Treat every disappointment as something to measure against what you have endured, competing for whose feelings deserve greater weight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay seated while I open this letter. Your face looks reassuring.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can open it without me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Keep looking like that while I prove it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know what's inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You weren't supposed to let your face hear that.

card.title: My Safe Person
card.instruction: Use one person’s reactions as your measure of safety, then downplay how much their reassurance changes you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit beside me for the result. It's only a better viewing angle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want me here because you're nervous.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. The chair arrangements are emotionally practical.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. My angle's improved already.

card.title: My Safe Person
card.instruction: Use one person’s reactions as your measure of safety, then downplay how much their reassurance changes you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could we use any cups except the blue ones today?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happened with a blue cup?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nothing breakfast needs to revisit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put it away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Behind the plates, please. The handle's still looking this way.

card.title: Careful Around the Scar
card.instruction: Treat one harmless detail as the trigger for an old hurt. Become overly careful, helpful, or controlled whenever it returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't open that yellow envelope beside the cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's only a bill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it can wait somewhere less festive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are you wiping the table again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Making room for everything except the envelope.

card.title: Careful Around the Scar
card.instruction: Treat one harmless detail as the trigger for an old hurt. Become overly careful, helpful, or controlled whenever it returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You opened your rejection letter straight away. Must be nice, being brave on demand.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was scared too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You hid it very efficiently.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Take your time with yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd prefer to need exactly as little time as you.

card.title: Braver Than Me
card.instruction: Treat another person’s emotional courage as both inspiring and unfair, resenting how exposed or hesitant it makes you feel.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You told them how you felt without rehearsing. I resent how impressive that was.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stumbled over half of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even your stumbling looked courageous.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Want to practise with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Don't make practising look easy too.

card.title: Braver Than Me
card.instruction: Treat another person’s emotional courage as both inspiring and unfair, resenting how exposed or hesitant it makes you feel.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've written when the shop opens, not if.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We should be realistic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I tried realistic for five years. It never painted the sign.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if nobody comes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let hopeful me choose the opening hours first.

card.title: Before I Knew Better
card.instruction: Perform the more hopeful version of yourself from before disappointment taught you caution, and defend that version when reality intrudes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm entering the talent show like I did at seventeen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You hated losing then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I loved entering before I learned that part.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you be okay?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask me after one completely unqualified yes.

card.title: Before I Knew Better
card.instruction: Perform the more hopeful version of yourself from before disappointment taught you caution, and defend that version when reality intrudes.

transfer.action: I put my old coping list beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I learned this the hard way before it had a name. {request}
transfer.response: Try my first minute before dismissing the method. {counter}
transfer.challenge: Your way might not suit me.
transfer.closing: Then at least discover what my years of practice have to offer.

transfer.action: I fold the hopeful napkin away from {prop}.
transfer.opening: No, that's quite all right. I'll lower my expectations. {request}
transfer.response: I was hoping for something else, that's all. {counter}
transfer.closing: Only in the part of the promise I had prepared to believe.

transfer.action: I set {prop} beside the plan we once drew on a napkin.
transfer.opening: We believed every word on this. {request}
transfer.response: Name one part of the old hope that still fits. {counter}
transfer.closing: Together. That's the part I don't want to fold away.

transfer.action: I place the scarf you lent me that night beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: You got me through it once. {request}
transfer.response: Speak in the voice that stayed until morning. {counter}
transfer.closing: I don't need the entire rescue. Start by not giving me the careful version.

transfer.action: I move {prop} within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
transfer.response: I can handle the difficult calls as well. {counter}
transfer.challenge: Who is taking care of you?
transfer.closing: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

transfer.action: I place my thicker bundle of disappointments beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I'm not comparing, but count the envelopes. {request}
transfer.response: Mine was a rough year, not just a rough week. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then it won't hurt to notice whose reference pile is larger.

transfer.action: I watch your face before uncovering {prop}.
transfer.opening: If you're calm, I can start. {request}
transfer.response: It's only a better angle, sitting this close. {counter}
transfer.closing: Your face was meant to make that uncertainty smaller first.

transfer.action: I push the familiar blue cup away from {prop}.
transfer.opening: No problem. Let's use a different colour. {request}
transfer.response: I'm tidying, not reacting to that memory. {counter}
transfer.challenge: What is wrong with the cup?
transfer.closing: Nothing we need to put in the middle of this conversation.

transfer.action: I copy your steady breath above {prop}, with a resentful smile.
transfer.opening: You make courage look like breathing. {request}
transfer.response: I'll do it just as bravely, with a little preparation. {counter}
transfer.closing: I'd rather take the amount you needed and make it look easier.

transfer.action: I replace if with when in the notes beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: The old me wouldn't have hedged. {request}
transfer.response: Let's finish one hopeful sentence without qualifying it. {counter}
transfer.closing: Realism has had several years. I'm giving hope a turn with the pen.
